newsitem.title: TAIWAN: First Int'l for Compaq OEM deal.
newsitem.headline: First Int'l for Compaq OEM deal.

text.p: Taiwan's First International Computer said on Wednesday it was negotiating an order with U.S.-based Compaq Computer Corp to make Compaq desktop computers and motherboards.
A First International spokesman said the two firms were discussing a deal, but declined to confirm a local newspaper report that it would be worth T$10 billion.

"We are negotiating an OEM (original equipment manufacturing) deal with Compaq, but we have not talked about how many computers or motherboards would be included in the deal," spokesman Lee Tung-han said by telephone.
"Therefore it is not possible to give a specific number right now," he added.
Lee said First International had signed a non-disclosure agreement with Compaq under which neither sides can comment on the negotiations until a deal is finalised.
Lee said he could not give a timetable for the negotiation.
